id: title:Gilbert09:add twelve labs knowledge store item tags table

review.posthog_relevance: Adds ingestion support for TwelveLabs knowledge store item tags, expanding warehouse coverage and enabling hierarchical data retrieval.
review.reason: Adds a new ingestion endpoint and configuration support for TwelveLabs item tags, including metadata and time ranges, and updates documentation. This represents a substantive, bounded capability improvement.
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the observed addition of ingestion and configuration support. The actual benefit, such as customer adoption or downstream analytics usage, is not demonstrated in the code and cannot be inferred.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, complete change group. No missing context or unrelated PRs detected. No tier assignment requested.

observations.behavior: Adds a new TwelveLabs ingestion endpoint for knowledge store item tags, including configuration, two-level fan-out implementation, tests and documentation.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds ingestion of item tags from TwelveLabs, including metadata and time ranges, into PostHog warehouse. This expands warehouse coverage and enables downstream analytics on tagged video segments.

observations.behavior: Updates documentation and configuration comments to reflect the new endpoint and its parameters.
observations.posthog_connection: Clarifies the API documentation URL for the new item tags endpoint, supporting accurate configuration and troubleshooting.

observations.behavior: Updates configuration comments and the fan_out_over parameter to support knowledge store items as a parent for fan-out.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the ingestion system to fan out over knowledge store items, enabling retrieval of nested item tags. This supports hierarchical data ingestion and retrieval.
